# spiceai_regions (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of available deployment regions for Spice.ai apps.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `env` (String) Filter by environment: `prod` or `dev`. If not specified, returns all regions.

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) The default region identifier.
- `regions` (Attributes List) List of available regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `cname` (String) The CNAME for the region (e.g., `us-west-2-prod-aws-data`).
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether this region is disabled.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default region.
- `name` (String) The display name of the region (e.g., `US East (Ohio)`).
- `provider` (String) The cloud provider identifier (e.g., `aws`).
- `provider_name` (String) The cloud provider display name (e.g., `AWS`).
- `region` (String) The region identifier (e.g., `us-east-2`).
